messages:
Aisha S: Quick handoff — just closed Moby Labs (mid-market). Contract signed. Notes: need Private deployment (VPC), Okta SAML SSO, expected go-live target ~6 weeks, initial traffic ~50 qps gen with potential spikes to ~200 qps during launch. Renewal in 11 months; upsell opportunity for Dedicated GPUs. Risks: legal flagged data residency, and they require a quantized model variant. Sales owner: Aisha S (I'll stay on contract).

Miguel R: Thanks — I'll take ownership for onboarding. Proposed immediate next steps:
• Kickoff with customer + tech owners (target Tue 10am PT)
• Prework: collect SAML metadata, sample payloads, expected tokens per request
• Enablement session (Ruchi), private deployment scoping (Liam)
I'll add items to the runbook and assign owners.

Ruchi P: I can run enablement. Need access to the customer's Okta dev tenant or SAML metadata and 3 example prompts. Will prepare a 90-min enablement deck + quickstart playbook.

Liam K: Noted. For private deploy we'll need:
- model family and size
- max sequence length
- estimated concurrent sessions and KV cache expectations
I'll prepare infra checklist by EOD Wed. Ballpark: likely 4xA100 or 8xH600 depending on quantization and perf targets.

SupportLead - Priya: I'll own post-go-live support and SLA. Recommend adding a dedicated runbook and adding them to enterprise support rotation. Also confirm escalation path to Eng on-call.

DeployBot: New ticket created: #INC-2143 for private-deploy scoping (assigned: Liam K).

Aisha S: Thanks team. Sales risk rating: LOW -> but data residency & SSO are blockers until legal signs off. I'll introduce the customer's security lead in thread and share contract notes. Also pushing for Dedicated upsell; flag to CS once deployment sizing is locked.

Miguel R: I'll schedule kickoff for Tue 10am PT and send calendar with agenda. Next deliverables: Ruchi to send prework checklist by EOD Mon, Liam infra checklist by Wed EOD, Priya to draft support handover doc before go-live.

Ruchi P: Added prework checklist link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/moby-prework (internal).

Miguel R: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
